jobs.occupation: Senior Principal Program Manager – Product Development
jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US, US

Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!

WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

Product Development at SimCorp is building a Strategic Program Management capability from the ground up. We are a 3,000-person fintech on a mission to be the world's leading investment management platform, and Product Development, our largest organizational unit with around 1,600 people, is where the work gets done. Programs and projects of real strategic consequence are already in motion.

This role sits within the Strategy & Transformation team, working directly alongside the Senior Director of Strategy & Execution. You will help drive a portfolio of cross-functional programs and projects spanning AI strategy execution, engineering tooling, process transformation, compliance, and platform migration. The work is varied, consequential, and visible at the most senior levels.

If you are a hands-on program manager who thrives on complexity, builds structure in ambiguous environments, and gets things done across a matrixed organization by building trust and collaborating across teams, this is your role.

WHAT YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

• Own delivery of a defined set of cross-functional programs and projects from the Product Development portfolio, with full accountability for outcomes, milestones, risks, and stakeholder communication.

• Role model, define and drive how Strategic Program Management operates inside Product Development, with regard to standards, tools, and ways of working.

• Coach and assist colleagues leading programs and projects in PD.

• Coordinate across Product Management, Platform, and Application Engineering to resolve cross-functional dependencies and keep delivery on track and aligned to our strategic goals.

• Partner with Change & Organizational Development and the wider organization where programs require shifts in ways of working or organizational behavior.

The current portfolio of initiatives spans AI transformation, platform migration and tooling, delivery model transformation, change of ways of working, and compliance and risk governance. These are live initiatives with delivery pressure, cross-unit dependencies, and direct visibility at CPTO and senior leadership level. Initiatives vary in scale and complexity, and the mix evolves with Product Development's strategic priorities.

WHO YOU ARE

You are an experienced, hands-on and pragmatic program manager who combines structured thinking with the interpersonal confidence to drive accountability in a matrixed organization. You know that getting things done in a matrixed organization depends on understanding what other teams need, not just what you need from them. That takes investment in relationships, not just process, and you invest in both.

You are comfortable holding multiple programs or projects simultaneously, switching between strategic and operational thinking as the situation demands. You produce crisp updates and governance material, and you escalate early rather than late.

The combination of technical tooling, AI strategy, process optimization, and compliance work in this portfolio does not intimidate you. You do not need to be the subject matter expert. You need to be the person who ensures the right people are in the room and the work moves forward in a collaborative way. Ambiguity and competing demands do not unsettle you. You find the practical path and bring people with you.

WHAT WE VALUE

• 6+ years in program or project management roles, ideally with some years within a technology or product development organization.

• Proven ability to manage complex, cross-functional initiatives with multiple workstreams and senior stakeholder engagement.

• Experience across both structured program management (governance, planning, risk management) and delivery-focused project execution.

• Experience building or improving program management practices, governance, and ways of working that teams and senior leaders use.

• Familiarity with engineering tooling environments and the ability to coordinate technical migrations or platform implementations without being the technical lead.

• Experience with compliance-related programs (GDPR, RoPA, ERM) is a plus.

• Outstanding written and verbal communication. You produce crisp executive material and inspire confidence in senior leadership forums.

• A direct, structured, and collaborative working style. You build alignment without softening the hard conversations.

• Degree in business, engineering, computer science, or a related field. Project management certification (PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent) is a plus.

BENEFITS

Attractive salary, bonus scheme, and pension are essential for any work agreement. However, in SimCorp, we believe we can offer more. Therefore, in addition to the traditional benefit scheme, we provide a good work and work-life balance: flexible working hours and a hybrid model. And opportunities for professional development: there is never just only one route - we offer an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take.

NEXT STEPS

Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually**. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed.** At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photos, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.

If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on a positive growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.

We are focused on continually improving our talent acquisition process and making everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.

Join a leading international life science company in an exciting role and assume end-to-end responsibility for a high-impact role at the intersection of operational strategy and execution.

Lead a Complex Global Clinical Study with strategic impact

As Clinical Trial Program Lead, you will play a key role in shaping and executing the company’ clinical development strategy. Reporting to the Head of Clinical Operations, you will assume responsibility for a strategically important Global Clinical Study while influencing the future direction of the company’s development portfolio.

Operating in an outsourced model, you will provide strategic oversight of CROs and external partners, ensuring clinical programs are delivered to the highest standards of quality, compliance, timelines, and budget. You will serve as a trusted partner to senior stakeholders, driving cross-functional decision-making, managing program risks, and translating development objectives into successful execution.

Beyond study delivery, you will contribute to lifecycle management, portfolio development, and the evaluation of future business opportunities, combining scientific insight, business acumen, and operational excellence to create long-term value. This is a highly visible role offering a rare combination of strategic influence, broad organizational exposure, and ownership of complex global development activities.

Global Clinical Study Leadership in an outsourced setup

You bring extensive experience from the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry and a proven track record of leading complex global clinical development programs. Operating in fully outsourced environments, you have successfully provided strategic oversight of CROs and external partners while maintaining accountability for quality, timelines, budgets, and study outcomes.

You combine a strong understanding of clinical development, global regulatory requirements, and ICH-GCP with the ability to translate scientific and business objectives into executable strategies. With sound business acumen and a strategic mindset, you are comfortable influencing senior stakeholders, navigating complex matrix organizations, and driving cross-functional decisions that create value and accelerate delivery.

Personally, you thrive in environments characterized by complexity, accountability, and change. You balance strategic perspective with operational pragmatism, bringing sound judgment, resilience, and a strong sense of ownership to everything you do. Through credibility and collaboration, you create alignment across stakeholders and build momentum around shared objectives.

Most importantly, you are motivated by shaping the direction of clinical development programs, challenging established thinking, and delivering meaningful outcomes for patients, the business, and the broader development portfolio.

Become Part of an Ambitious Growth Journey

This is an opportunity to join an international and innovation-driven life science organization at an exciting stage of development. You will have significant influence on critical clinical studies and work closely with senior stakeholders across the business, helping to shape future development activities and strategic priorities. The recruitment process is carried out by Venaris Executive Search. For more information regarding the position, please reach out to Sr. Executive Search Consultant, Lars Nordlund, on +45 3123 3018. All requests will be handled confidentially. If this position is for you, do not hesitate to apply by uploading your CV - it is not necessary to include a cover letter.

**Your impact begins here

**As Safety Surveillance Principal Specialist, you will lead the safety surveillance strategy for responses to Health Authority questions across Novo’s incretin portfolio, mainly within diabetes and obesity treatment. You will drive benefit–risk thinking, influence critical decisions and represent Safety Surveillance in Health Authority meetings. Your judgement helps ensure the safety of treatments for people living with serious chronic diseases is understood clearly and communicated on time.

**What You’ll Bring

**You are an experienced, scientifically driven colleague who thrives on complex safety challenges and turns data into meaningful insight.

**We Imagine You Have

**

• A master’s degree in Life Sciences (e.g. Pharmacy, Medicine, Veterinary Medicine or Biology).

• Extensive experience within drug safety, pharmacovigilance, drug development processes, global regulatory requirements, GxP standards and medical concepts.

• Demonstrated ability to identify challenges, shape strategies and translate them into clear, actionable steps.

• Strong stakeholder management and the ability to influence decisions through clear, concise communication.

• Solid experience with Health Authority negotiations, including meetings.

• The ability to communicate clearly, in writing and verbally, and to turn complexity into clear recommendations.

• A self-driven, ethical and adaptable approach: you work independently, address issues proactively and stay flexible when situations or priorities change.

• A team-player mindset: you show empathy, take care of colleagues, build effective connections and collaborate seamlessly with internal and external stakeholders.

**What You’ll Do

**You will lead high-impact activities across the incretin portfolio, help set the direction for safety surveillance, and act as a trusted safety leader for key stakeholders. Clear communication, sound judgement and taking ownership will be part of your everyday work.

• Act as the safety surveillance lead for strategic, scientific responses to safety Q&A from all Health Authority interactions.

• Maintain overview of activities, including studies, submissions and questions and answers from Health Authorities.

• Represent Safety Surveillance in Health Authority meetings.

• Maintain overview of safety contributions to study reports, regulatory submissions, protocols and other key documents, and ensure relevant input to continued development activities.

• Contribute to benefit–risk communication and ensure clear, aligned and timely safety messaging for internal stakeholders and Health Authorities.

• Drive governance and decision-making across cross-functional areas and senior fora, and mentor colleagues by setting standards for scientific quality, decision-making and collaboration.

**Who You’ll Work With

**You will join the Post-Marketing Cardiometabolic III team in Safety Surveillance Post-Marketing, an area within Global Patient Safety based in Søborg, Denmark, with a department in Bangalore, India. The area has global responsibility for the portfolio of marketed products and consists of 7 teams across Denmark and India.

As a team, we are the bridge between clinical development and post-marketing. We handle clinical studies and submissions and lead strategic, scientific responses to safety Q&A from Health Authorities around the world on our GLP-1 portfolio.

You will work both independently and through others, building strong partnerships with colleagues across Clinical Development, Medical & Science, Regulatory Affairs, Biostatistics and other functional areas. Medical & Science will be a particularly close partner, and together you will keep decisions timely and scientific quality high. The environment is dynamic, collaborative and highly science driven. We value diverse perspectives, because the strongest outcomes emerge when people with different experiences and expertise work together.

**What You Can Expect Here

**You will be trusted to take ownership, make your voice heard and lead from the front, while informally guiding junior colleagues and growing alongside highly skilled, enthusiastic colleagues. You will work at the intersection of science, drug development and regulatory strategy, with room to keep building your expertise through relevant learning offerings and experience across functions.

Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 847,000.00 to 1,245,100.00 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area, and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

**Start now

**Your impact begins today. If you are ready to shape how safety is understood and communicated for treatments that matter to millions of people, apply for the Safety Surveillance Principal Specialist role by **15 November 2026.

**We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

Through your involvement in these projects, you will broaden your global network, enhance your cross-cultural communication skills, and gain firsthand experience in navigating the complexities of international collaboration.

Your Mission

You’ll be the person who makes sure Klimate’s numbers are accurate, on time and a reliable source of truth. As our Finance Manager, you’ll own the books, the close and the reporting, as well as the data behind them. You’ll make sure what goes into our finance reports is correct, traceable and something leadership can rely on.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys both finance and data. The foundation is finance: closing the books, reconciling balances and working with our external bookkeepers and auditors. Alongside that, you’ll use SQL, BI and automation, including AI, to validate data across systems, remove manual steps and improve how finance and operations work together. If you like figuring things out and building the solution yourself, there’s a lot of room to do that here.

Finance at Klimate is closely tied to the business. Every contract, credit delivery and supplier payment shows up in the numbers, so you’ll get a front-row view of how the company actually runs. You’ll work side by side with our CFO on strategic matters, while still rolling up your sleeves to get the foundations right. You’ll have a big impact on how we scale.

About Klimate

At Klimate, we enable companies pursuing real climate action to take responsibility for the emissions they can’t avoid. The world talks a lot about net-zero, but most companies struggle to know what to do once reductions are no longer enough. That’s where we come in. We are a science-led business with real experts guiding companies through the world of carbon removal and how they can safely invest in taking CO₂ out of the atmosphere. Our solution combines expertise, guidance and software to help companies understand what’s real, what works, what it costs, and how to do it credibly.

Founded in 2020, we are a tight-knit team of around 20 people from a great variety of nationalities united by a passion for scaling solutions to the climate crisis. We move quickly when it matters and focus on sharing ownership along the way. Besides working in teams we enable that ownership in squads making it possible for all employees to lead areas, they are passionate about. We value deep collaboration and working side-by-side in our central Copenhagen office, from where we support leading clients including Implement Consulting, Nykredit, Copenhagen Airport and many others.

You can get to know us a bit better on our website or on LinkedIn.

What You'll Do

In your first 3–6 months: keep the numbers right and make the data trustworthy

• Learn Klimate’s commercial and accounting flows from contracts and allocation through invoicing, payments, credit delivery, revenue recognition and balance-sheet treatment.

• Own the month-end and year-end close from start to finish. You’ll work with our external bookkeeper and make sure the final numbers are right, keep payables and receivables on track, follow up on late payments, and support the annual audit.

• Be the quality gate for our external bookkeepers. Give them the right input, check their output, and make sure what reaches the CFO is correct.

• Deliver practical improvements to priority finance/data flows and reporting processes, reducing manual hand-offs and reconciliation where possible. This includes establishing a documented discrepancy-management process.

• Spot the first manual, error-prone steps in our workflows and start fixing them.

• Support with operational and ad hoc tasks that keep the business running smoothly.

From there: build what’s missing and give management the full picture

• Build the dashboards and overviews leadership uses to steer the company, from cash and margins to carbon-credit stock.

• Collaborate closely with the CFO on management reporting. Support budgeting, forecasting and long-term financial planning.

• Decide how new deal types, supplier agreements and carbon-credit purchases should be handled in our accounting, and make sure the treatment holds up at audit.

• Set up and continuously improve our finance processes, systems and controls. Automate wherever it makes sense, using whatever tools fit, AI included.

• Own reliable, traceable datasets and reporting that support finance and cross-functional decisions.

• Lead a prioritised roadmap for improving end-to-end data flows and related processes across finance, purchasing, allocation and stock. Collaborate with technical colleagues on integrations and data-models, including bringing AI-supported automations into our workflows.

Requirements and Skills

Must-haves

• Solid accounting experience, including owning the books for a whole entity, with a strong understanding of the P&L, balance sheet and cash flow. You take pride in reconciliations that tie out, and you always trace discrepancies back to their source.

• Experience with the full finance cycle: month-end close, management reporting, annual accounts and working with auditors.

• Advanced Excel modelling skills, practical SQL experience such as writing queries and joining datasets, and a good understanding of BI tools.

• Experience with automating workflows, tasks or reporting, and using AI in practice. You’ve taken manual, complicated processes and made them faster, simpler or automatic.

• Financial analysis skills and the ability to turn data and numbers into clear, evidence-based recommendations.

• Professional English is required. Being able to read and understand Danish is preferred.

Nice-to-have

• Solid knowledge of Danish accounting rules, VAT and statutory reporting requirements.

• Experience from a smaller company, with hands-on internal finance ownership.

• Knowledge of carbon credit and allowance allocation is a plus.

• Experience and interest in climate, sustainability or carbon markets is highly valued.

Who You Are

• Reliable and trustworthy, with high integrity. You check your own work and make sure the underlying data and the reporting agree.

• Self-driven and you follow through. You see tasks through to completion and ask for input along the way when you need it.

• Energised by a blank page. You’re comfortable with ambiguity and enjoy building structure where there isn’t any yet.

• Curious about the business. You want to understand why the numbers look the way they do, not just report them.

• A clear communicator. You work well across teams, and you’re not afraid to hold others accountable. You have the judgement to know when to push back, and the pragmatism to find a way that works.

What We Offer

Beyond our mission and team culture, we aim to provide a workplace where you can grow professionally and contribute meaningfully to an industry that is rapidly evolving. We offer a competitive compensation package, opportunities to develop your skills, and an environment built on ownership, collaboration and trust.

Benefits

• Vacation: 30 days of paid holiday (5 weeks + 1 week of “feriefridage”).

• Pension & health insurance: Employer-supported pension scheme including health insurance.

• Learning & development: Annual learning budget to support your professional growth.

• Warrants: Eligibility for our warrant program depending on role and seniority.

• Flexibility: We have a weekly work from home day, and offer flexibility in working times and locations as needed.

• Central office location with lunch and great coffee: Cozy office located right next to Nørreport with a catered vegetarian lunch every day and excellent coffee provided by our clients Original Coffee and Prolog.

• Social activities: Weekly wrap up sessions every Friday and a variety of social activities, from foraging and cooking in Amager to trying our hand at pottery.

Start & Logistics

We will review applications on an ongoing basis and hire when we find the right candidate.

Start date: ASAP

Job level (internal scale): Level 8 - Junior Expert (A developing professional who demonstrates potential and aptitude in a specific area of expertise. They possess foundational knowledge and skills, acquired through education, training, and practical experience. Typically guided by a Senior Expert and/or mentor)

What to include in your application

• Your CV and a short cover letter (PDF) - please highlight in the Cover Letter how you are combining finance and data or automations in your work

• Please leave out photos and identifying characteristics such as age, gender, nationality, etc.

Our hiring process

• 30 min intro interview with our People & Culture Partner

• Interview and short assignment or case with CFO + a team member

The final candidate will have:

• Reference check

• Final conversation with our CEO, Mads Emil

• Offer

How to apply: If you're interested in the role, please apply by filling in this form and selecting “Finance Manager - Data & BI”.

Equal Opportunities

Klimate is committed to equal opportunities for all people and ideas.

Even if you think you don’t meet all the requirements, we encourage you to apply.

We encourage applicants from all backgrounds to apply and strive to ensure an objective selection process.

Please leave out your date of birth, gender, marital status, nationality, photo, and other personal characteristics from your CV and application.

**Your impact begins here

**As Accounting Manager, you will take full ownership of accounting and tax activities for your area in Business Area (BA) West and become the trusted first point of contact for the local Finance & Operations (F&O) Head and Line of Business. You will keep financial reporting accurate, timely and compliant, especially at month-end and year-end, and help make accounting simpler and more digital. Your work gives local teams the clarity to make decisions and keep moving at pace.

**What You’ll Bring

**You combine strong technical accounting with the confidence to partner with the business and challenge constructively.

• A master’s degree in business, finance, economics or a similar field.

• 5–8 years of relevant experience from finance, consulting, auditing or a comparable background.

• Solid experience in accounting and financial reporting, including month-end and year-end closing.

• Strong technical accounting skills and the ability to handle complex accounting matters.

• Experience performing financial controls and working within a control framework.

• Strong stakeholder-management and business-partnering skills, with the ability to explain complex accounting topics clearly to Finance and non-Finance colleagues.

• Knowledge of SAP.

• A structured, analytical and detail-oriented approach, and the ability to prioritise and deliver high-quality results under tight deadlines.

• A proactive, collaborative mindset, with the confidence to take ownership.

**What You’ll Do

**You will be accountable for the quality of accounting in your area and a visible partner to the people who depend on it.

• Take full accounting responsibility for your assigned area, with the tax activities that go with it.

• Act as first point of contact for the local F&O Head and Line of Business, giving accounting advice and business partnering.

• Perform complex accounting tasks during month-end close (MEC) and year-end close (YEC), delivering accurate, timely and compliant financial reporting.

• Carry out financial controls and make sure control activities are completed effectively and on time.

• Investigate accounting issues, identify risks and drive them to resolution.

• Improve accounting processes and ways of working through standardisation, simplification and digitalisation.

**Who You’ll Work With

**You will join the Accounting & Taxation BA West Centre of Excellence (CoE), based in Copenhagen (Ørestad), and report to the Associate Director Accounting & Taxation CoE. The CoE is responsible for accounting and tax across nine affiliates in 11 countries: Denmark & Iceland, Sweden, Norway, Switzerland, the Netherlands, Belgium & Luxembourg, Finland, Ireland and Portugal.

The team includesAccounting Managers and controllers who act as dedicated finance partners to individual affiliates, while two positions focus on the Business Area as a whole. Your closest partners will be the local F&O Head and Line of Business for your area, alongside colleagues across the wider Accounting & Taxation organisation. Together you build standardised, efficient ways of working that support high-quality financial management.

**What You Can Expect Here

**You will be trusted to own your area and make your voice heard, with clear expectations for the quality and timeliness of your work. You will grow by working across markets, stakeholders and finance disciplines, and by contributing to how accounting is improved and digitalised across Business Area West. You will be supported by colleagues who give and ask for honest feedback so that everyone can perform at their best.

• Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 650,960.00 to 956,860.00 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

**Start now

**Your impact begins today. If you are ready to own accounting in your area and partner with the business to deliver high-quality results, upload your CV and apply before 19.11.2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

jobs.occupation: Project lead (strain engineering for client delivery)
jobs.description:
Enduro Genetics is a world-leading biotech at the interface of synthetic biology and biomanufacturing. Our platform product Enduro Sense is a transformative gene technology that redefines the capabilities of cells in fermentation. Enduro Sense is used for cell-based expression systems and production strains to deliver higher titer, rate and yields, making biomanufacturing more efficient and scalable.

As we expand to meet growing client demands, we are seeking a results-driven and people-oriented Project Lead to oversee our microbial strain engineering projects with clients.

Who You Are:

This role is perfect for a senior science leader passionate about leveraging synthetic biology to create tangible biomanfacturing step-ups for clients while fostering team growth and motivation. You thrive in fast-paced settings, communicate clearly and are eager to join a rapidly scaling company, currently around 25 employees.

Responsibilities:

• Lead and mentor high-performing R&D teams to drive project success.

• Develop and implement research strategies to meet key milestones.

• Oversee client projects to ensure timely progress and impactful results.

• Collaborate with scientists and stakeholders of all levels to deliver on project timelines and deliverables.

• Provide expert technical guidance to support project outcomes.

What You Bring:

• Education: PhD in Synthetic Biology, Molecular Biology, or a related discipline.

• Industry Experience: 7+ years in microbial strain engineering, with corporate expertise in pharmaceutical or industrial bioprocesses.

• Technical Expertise:

• Strong background in production strain technology, recombinant protein expression, or metabolite production.

• Proven track-record in developing microbial strains for bioprocesses.

• Leadership: Exceptional project management skills, including team mentorship and development.

• Analytical and Communication: Ability to solve complex problems and communicate effectively incl. in written and oral presentations.

• Adaptability: Capacity to excel in a dynamic, fast-growing organization.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience leading agile R&D teams.

• Technical strain engineering experience in Bacillus, E. coli, Corynebacterium or yeasts (Pichia, S. cerevisiae etc)

• Familiarity with corporate bioprocess development workflows.

• Knowledge of Design of Experiments (DoE), small-scale automation, and fermentation science.

• Background in pharmaceutical GMP environments.

• Relevant experience from e.g. a CDMO or CRO on delivering projects with clients or collaboration partners

Why Join Enduro Genetics?

At Enduro, you'll play a vital role roling out our technology to leading clients, shaping the future of biomanufacturing. Be part of a collaborative and innovative environment where your contributions make a difference.

If you're ready to advance your career in industrial biotechnology and lead impactful projects, apply now to join our team.

Applications will be screened regularly

We are partnering exclusively with our Private Equity client as they build out their new Commercial Finance capability to support the next phase of growth. This is highly commercial leadership role, embedded within the business and partnering directly with senior operational and commercial stakeholders - rather than sitting within a traditional reporting function, you'll operate at the heart of decision-making, helping leadership teams navigate growth, complexity and change while shaping how commercial performance is understood and managed across the organisation.

As Commercial Finance Director, you will act as the senior commercial sparring partner to your leadership team, turning financial and operational data into clear insights that drive action. You'll identify the key drivers behind performance, challenge assumptions, evaluate strategic opportunities and ensure investment, pricing and resource decisions are grounded in sound commercial thinking. Working closely with business leaders, you'll build robust business cases, highlight risks and opportunities before they emerge in reported results, and create greater accountability around performance. Success in the role will come from your ability to influence senior stakeholders, balance commercial judgement with analytical rigour, and provide the constructive challenge needed to improve outcomes.

About You

• Experience in Commercial Finance, Strategy, Consulting, Sales Operations or a similarly commercial and analytical environment ideally within the Technology/SaaS industry.

• Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and shape business decisions.

• Strong commercial acumen with a genuine interest in understanding business performance and growth drivers.

• Comfortable moving between strategic thinking and hands-on analysis.

• Experience partnering with senior operational or commercial leaders.

• Confidence to challenge assumptions, push back where necessary and provide an independent viewpoint.

• Strong communication skills with the ability to present complex issues clearly and concisely.

jobs.description:
WHO YOU ARE

Are you ready to join us in ensuring our customers receive the best experience with timely and accurate order fulfilment?

We are seeking a detail-oriented and organized Fulfilment Operations Coordinator to join our Logistics Team. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring the efficient and timely picking of Click & Collect and Cash & Carry orders, contributing to a seamless customer experience. Your primary goal is to coordinate order

fulfillment processes, ensuring accuracy, speed, and quality service.

To be successful in this job, you:

• Must have experience in Logistics, Order fulfilment or Warehouse operations

• Have strong organizational and problem-solving skills

• Are able to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment

• Have excellent communication and teamwork abilities

• Have attention to detail and a commitment to quality

Basic knowledge of inventory managements systems is a plus.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

• Conduct daily operational planning, provide an overview, delegate tasks based on priorities, and collaborate with team members to optimize workflow and productivity.

• Oversee and support the team, as well as perform tasks within the main areas of responsibility, including picking and packing goods and orders for Click & Collect and Cash & Carry, all within the agreed time with a focus on the customer.

• Work closely with the Replenishment Team for morning handovers and prepare for evening replenishment.

• Maintain a clean, organized, and safe environment throughout the fulfillment unit. Ensure adherence and compliance with all safety requirements by performing weekly safety checks and more.

• Monitor inventory levels, communicate any shortages or issues, follow up on empty locations to ensure inventory accuracy, and process all returns.

• Follow up on the heatmap and move goods to optimize business operations.

• Ensure a smooth daily handover to team leaders and support them in various tasks and projects as they arise.

OUR TEAM WITHIN IKEA

Here you will become part of our international team of both full-time and part-time employees working towards a common goal. We ensure efficient logistics in the store and provide excellent customer service, even without direct customer contact. You'll gain experience collaborating with various departments and diverse individuals. Join our fantastic logistics team, where we strive daily for a development-focused and well-being environment for our many colleagues.

QUESTIONS AND SUPPORT? LET'S CONNECT!

If you have job specific questions please contact Sara Unger, Fulfilment Operations Team Leader, sara.unger@ingka.ikea.com.

Please note that we only receive applications via our recruitment system and not via e-mail

Further information

• This position is for an average of 37 hours per week.

• Your working time will vary based on the business need, with both morning and evening shifts within the hours 06:00-20:30. You should also expect to work every 2nd weekend, both Saturday and Sunday. It is possible to give your input to the work schedule.

• Salary is within IKEA's banding and HK's Union agreement for logistics and includes free choice allowance, odd-hour payment and pension.

• Start date is as early as possible.

• Apply latest 15th of November 2026

• We have an ongoing interview process and reserve the right to close the job when we have received enough qualified candidates.

Like homes, talent is also diverse, and in IKEA we have a passion for real people. When applying for jobs, some are discouraged if they do not meet every single competence area, but please feel free to still apply. We would love to get to know you as there is a wide range of opportunities in IKEA, based on desire, ability, and experience. We hope you will join us on this adventure and we are looking forward to hearing from you!

Help build a medtech company's commercial engine – from the ground up

At Cebreo Medical we have spent more than 15 years turning ear-EEG research into NeuroBuds™: a small, discreet, CE-marked EEG device that records brain activity for weeks at home rather than for a single night in a lab. We are now taking it to market in sleep and epilepsy, both in clinical trials with pharma, biotech and CROs and in clinical use.

Our commercial team is small, and the foundation is still being built. We are looking for a young talent who wants to roll up their sleeves and help build it, working side by side with our CCO.

What you will do

This is a hands-on role. Your days will be about getting things done and moving things forward in the market, not about internal processes.

• Find and prepare customers: research which biotechs and CROs are running relevant studies and who makes the decisions, and build target lists our sales team can act on

• Equip sales: turn our value propositions into sharp customer materials, proposals and tender responses for epilepsy, sleep and pharma/biotech

• Keep the engine running: CRM discipline, pipeline follow-up and a simple monthly KPI and forecast rhythm

• Know the market: track competitors, key opinion leaders and market developments, and turn them into concrete actions

• Support market access: help the CCO with evidence and value materials and payer analyses

• Make our voice heard: LinkedIn, website updates and congress activities

• Drive initiatives across teams: work with Clinical Operations, Data Science, Scientific Affairs and R&D to get things delivered

As we grow, the role grows with you. You will have the chance to take ownership of a commercial area where your interests and our needs meet.

Who you are

• A doer. You prefer delivering to planning, finish what you start and are happy to take the next step without waiting to be asked

• Curious about AI. You already use AI tools to work faster and smarter in research, analysis and content, and you are curious about how AI can help a lean team punch above its weight

• Structured and analytical, with high-quality output and an eye for what really matters

• Brings energy to a team, has a low ego and is good at bringing people together across functions

• M.Sc. in business, economics, engineering, life science or similar

• 1–4 years of experience from commercial, strategy or consulting roles; medtech or life science is a plus

• Fluent English; Danish is an advantage

What we offer

• A rare chance to help build a commercial organisation from scratch, with real responsibility from day one

• An informal start-up culture – in a solid setting, backed by strong ownership and good working conditions

• Close collaboration with and sparring from an experienced CCO

• Technology with a unique story, strong science and a big market potential

• Competitive salary and pension

Start and application

• Start: As soon as possible

• How to apply: Apply with your CV via LinkedIn – no cover letter needed, just answer the short screening questions. Shortlisted candidates will get a short practical task (max. 1 hour) before the first interview. We review applications continuously and may close the posting early, so don't wait.

Paarup, Region Midtjylland, DK, 7442

**HR Business Partner - International Role

**Experienced HR professional with an international mindset?

We are looking for an experienced and trusted HR Business Partner who enjoys working close to managers, employees and colleagues at our headquarters in Pårup.

This is an international role in which you will support selected business areas across countries and cultures throughout the employee journey. You will advise managers on organisational development, employee relations, recruitment, employment conditions and day-to-day leadership matters. You will also be responsible for coordinating and developing MASCOT's trainee programmes.

You will join an experienced HR team and report to the HR Manager.

Your key responsibilities

• Advise and support managers on leadership, employee relations and organisational development

• Manage recruitment processes from job profile to final employment

• Handle employee cases, including absence, difficult conversations, terminations and exit interviews

• Ensure compliance with employment legislation, contracts, policies and local employment conditions

• Plan and quality-assure onboarding activities

• Support international HR projects, employee surveys, workshops and annual HR activities

• Coordinate trainee recruitment, training plans and ongoing development

• Collaborate with managers and colleagues across MASCOT's international organisation

What you bring

You have at least five years of experience as an HR Business Partner or HR Consultant. You are confident in advising managers and comfortable handling both operational HR matters and broader organisational topics in an international business environment.

You are structured, responsible and able to move tasks from initiation to completion. You communicate clearly, listen carefully and build trusted relationships across functions, countries and cultures. You use your business understanding to combine sound judgement with a practical and solution-oriented approach.

Experience with recruitment, employment law, coaching, conflict management and HR systems is important. Knowledge of SAP SuccessFactors and LinkedIn Recruiter is an advantage.

You are fluent in written and spoken English. Fluency in another European language would be a strong advantage.

What we offer

At MASCOT, you become part of a family-owned international company with strong values, ambitious goals and short decision-making paths.

• An international HR role based at our headquarters in Pårup

• A permanent onsite position with close collaboration across the organisation

• A professional and supportive HR team

• Pension, health insurance and wellbeing initiatives

• Excellent food in our staff restaurant

• Employee discounts on MASCOT workwear

Ready to make a difference?

Apply today. We review applications and invite candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis.

At MASCOT, we are united by passion, collaboration and the ambition to develop, manufacture and deliver the world's best workwear and safety footwear.

**Role and impact

**How do you help a new catalyst product move from development towards production? In this role, you’ll work at the practical heart of scale-up: designing, building and commissioning a catalyst production pilot line, then using it to run tests, develop process knowledge and deliver new capable products to our production plants. Your work will also support production teams with troubleshooting and help plant engineering make informed equipment decisions.

**Responsibilities

**Your primary objective will be to deliver capable new catalyst products, supported by well-established and understood process windows, to the industrialization step—the next stage in our new product development stage-gate model.

You will plan and carry out work safely, optimize equipment and processes, report your findings, and document relevant best practices. You will also work with production and engineering colleagues to address equipment and process needs.

**This Will Involve

**

• Designing, building and commissioning equipment for a catalyst production pilot line.

• Performing tests at the Manufacturing Development Centre, including completing safety assessments and reporting results.

• Troubleshooting production challenges and supporting problem-solving as a subject-matter expert in relevant unit operations and equipment.

• Assisting plant engineering and EPCM with equipment selection, testing (on site or at vendors) and reviews.

**What You Will Bring

**

• Equipment and/or unit operation subject matter expert in e.g. powder handling, milling, screening, continuous furnaces etc.

• Experience in Plant process engineering and commissioning experience

• Minimum 7 -10 years of relevant experience

• Experience troubleshooting and solving problems in industrial production processes.

• A practical, hands-on approach and confidence working directly with equipment.

• The ability to write clear, scientifically sound reports in English and communicate fluently in English, both spoken and written.

• Flexibility to manage changing priorities and work to tight timelines.

• Ability to work with several tasks and projects simultaneously, being robust/resilient when faced with challenges

**It Would Also Be An Advantage To Have

**

• Experience with production process scale-up or scale-down.

• Danish, both written and spoken or with a willingness to learn the language

• Project management experience.

• Knowledge of risk assessment, data handling or statistics

• Ability to think strategically and proactively seek information with respect to what is needed for future pilot development, Project manager experience, knowledge on risk assessment.

• Knowledge on data handling and statistics an advantage

**Why join us

**You’ll have the opportunity to be a part of accelerating new catalyst products to the market by building and operating a pilot facility, take part in practical testing, optimizing, and solve real equipment and production challenges. The role brings together design, hands-on problem-solving and technical reporting, with work that supports scale-up and manufacturing development.

**Your new Team

**You’ll join R&D’s Scale-up and Manufacturing Development team. You’ll work with colleagues involved in developing and industrializing new catalyst products, pilot testing, production troubleshooting and plant engineering support. The team’s work connects equipment and process development with the needs of industrial production.

**How You Can Apply

**If you would like to be part of a team of skilled and professional colleagues in an informal organization, please submit your documents in English.

**Application deadline: 23-11-2026.

**If you have questions regarding the role, feel free to reach out to Ninna Halberg Jokil, Director- Scale up and Manufacturing development, on NIH@topsoe.com.

You do not need to attach a cover letter to your application – just include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are applying. Please also avoid the use of photos in your CV. Both these measures are to ensure a fair and unbiased process.

We welcome applications from all qualified candidates, irrespective of their gender, age, religion, disability, ethnic background, and geographical location. We encourage individuals from diverse cultures and countries to apply and contribute to our global team.

To ensure a secure and trustworthy work environment, our recruitment process may include background checks, requests for criminal records, and contact with references.

To headhunters: Thank you for your interest in our company. However, we would like to inform you that we have a dedicated internal team managing our recruitment process. We kindly request that you refrain from reaching out to us regarding potential candidates. Thank you for your understanding.

**About Us

**Topsoe is a leading global provider of advanced technology and solutions for the energy transition.

Built on decades of scientific research and innovation, we are working with customers and partners to drive energy resiliency and to achieve their sustainability goals.

We offer world-leading solutions for transforming renewable resources into fuels and chemicals, and we provide technologies needed to produce low-carbon and conventional fuels and chemicals as well as ensuring clean air.

We were founded in 1940 and are headquartered in Denmark, with around 2,500 employees serving customers all around the globe. To learn more, visit www.topsoe.com.

At Topsoe we strive towards having a safe work environment. We are aware of the risks in our work and continuously optimize our safety procedures.

Do you want to be a valued part of the critical infrastructure that serves communities across Europe and beyond? Are you looking for a position in which you can set direction and help to shape our company? If so, then you could be the newest member of our team, Fleet Energy Efficiency Projects, as Superintendent, based at our Copenhagen office.

**About The Role

**Be part of the movement - and play your part.

As Superintendent, you will drive energy efficiency projects and execute shore power projects throughout the DFDS fleet of ~60 vessels. You will perform efficient and effective project management, continuous improvements, and standardisation across the fleet to reduce excess energy use and support the journey towards 2030 and further to net-zero in 2050.

This role is based full-time at our Copenhagen office. Being on-site here matters: you'll be working closely day-to-day with the wider Fleet Energy Efficiency Projects team and cross-functional partners across the organisation, and that close collaboration is a core part of how the role delivers results. Alongside this, the position involves a high level of interaction with our seafarers and many other partners in the shipping business, including Class and Flag, so you should expect regular travel (see below). We're looking for a proactive and passionate Superintendent who is thorough, efficient, and able to execute both at the desk and in the field, someone who enjoys travel, communicates well, and is equally comfortable working as part of a team and independently on their own tasks.

**In Addition, Your Key Responsibilities Will Include

**

• Identify and prioritise energy efficiency ideas.

• Perform efficient and effective project management from idea to installation, commissioning, and handover to the vessel.

• Carry out on-site technical supervision during project installation through planning and timely execution during scheduled dockings or in service.

• Documentation and archiving of relevant project data.

• Financial planning and execution, including close follow-up on projects.

• Continue to analyse and develop operational and technical methods and find efficient alternatives.

• Evaluate existing projects and analyse if any of these would be feasible across the remaining fleet.

• Analyse capital expenditures and project designs to find and implement efficient projects.

**Fleet Energy Efficiency Projects

**The department is a relatively new department, part of Fleet Resilience and Technology (the former Technical Organisation). Fleet Energy Efficiency Projects is responsible for specific energy-saving projects that support the decarbonisation journey towards 2030 and further to 2050.

**About You

**We believe the strongest teams are built on diversity and inclusivity. Contrasting opinions, varied skills, and strong characters bring out the best in all of us.

The ideal candidate will excel in project management and possess extensive technical knowledge in the marine segment. Most importantly, you should have strong social and behavioural skills to effectively interact with diverse cultures and a high motivation for driving continuous improvements by maintaining a clear focus on setting and achieving targets.

**We Expect The Following

**

• Marine Engineer, Dual Officer, or Naval Architect.

• Technical experience, knowledge, and high interest in Energy Efficiency, fuel-saving technologies, Alternative fuels, Ship performance monitoring, and Decarbonization.

• Strong analytic mind with both a theoretical and practical approach.

• Willingness to work in a complex organisational setup, across countries and cultures.

• Ability to engage and lead in a cross-functional team of experts across various projects.

• Not scared of engaging and taking difficult decisions.

• Ability to handle multiple tasks in a deadline-oriented environment.

• Proficient IT skills.

• English language proficiency, both written and spoken, at negotiation level.

• Able to be based in Copenhagen and work on-site, with travel of 60–90 days yearly, which can include longer periods during dockings, repairs, or in-service work.

**Working at DFDS

**Join the movement and grow with us.

At DFDS, we prioritise training and promote a culture of continuous professional and personal development. You'll join a team of skilled colleagues dedicated to excellence in an organisation known for accountability, respect, and enthusiasm. This role is based at our Copenhagen office - this is a firm requirement of the position, given the close, ongoing collaboration it involves with the local team and cross-functional partners.

**Are we a match? Then what are you waiting for? Apply Now.

**If you think your personality, skills, experience, and desire match this role, we'd love to hear from you. We're keen to meet potential candidates on an ongoing basis. We will be conducting interviews on an ongoing basis.

**About DFDS

**DFDS operates approximately 60 RoRo cargo and passenger vessels across several flags in Europe and the Mediterranean. DFDS runs a differentiated operational model, focusing on serving our Business Units to deliver safe and efficient operation of our fleet. This model supports scheduled services, enabling us to execute approximately 35,000 departures yearly.

**Company Description

****Join Oterra in making natural food and beverages easy, for a sustainable and healthy world.

**_Headquartered in Denmark, with production sites in Europe, Latin America, and the US, we’re a passionate team of over 1200 team members of 48 nationalities in 27 countries worldwide, serving 120 markets globally. As the leading worldwide provider of natural colors, we offer food and beverage manufacturers an alternative to artificial colors. Food and health are at the heart of everything we do and every day over 400 million people eat a product with our colors in it. We believe that nature got it right the first time.

_**Job Description

**We are looking for an experienced Group Financial Controller with interest and experience in driving continued improvements to our financial reporting process to join us at our global headquarters in Hellerup, Denmark.

As Group Financial Controller, you will be part of the team responsible for ensuring accurate, timely, and compliant preparation of the Oterra Group's financial reporting. The group financial reporting is prepared in accordance with IFRS and the accounting principles applied under Oterra’s senior financing agreements.

You will report to the Head of Group Controlling & Reporting, but close collaboration with finance teams across the Group Finance, Group Tax, Group Treasury, Business Finance, and senior management is expected to ensure high-quality financial information is delivered to stakeholders.

Just as importantly, you are able to communicate complex financial matters in a clear and pragmatic way. You combine strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail and enjoy working both independently and collaboratively across functions, cultures, and geographies.

Additional Information

At Oterra, we take care of our people – because when you’re supported, you can do your best work. Our

benefits are designed to support your health, your future and your life outside of work.

Activation at Sunrise TcTa is where business and brand strategy connect with content, creativity, media and tech. The team focuses on effectiveness — achieved through proven frameworks that align strategy and activation, driving measurable results for both Danish and international brands, mostly within the B2B sector.

We believe tactics without strategic understanding never lead to real impact… and the other way around.

Right now, we’re reshaping our setup to bring content, creative and media even closer to business and brand strategy.

About the position

We’re looking for a Paid Social Strategist to help set the direction for our paid media discipline within Activation together with the team and the management group.

You’ll bridge performance and media with strategy and creativity, ensuring that every campaign and initiatives delivers on marketing and sales KPIs as well as strategic objectives across brand, marketing and comms.

The role combines hands-on paid media management with strategic consultancy on LinkedIn and Meta.

It’s a plus if you also have experience with HubSpot and enjoy collaborating closely with our Content, Tech and Brand Strategy specialists.

Your tasks will include

• Plan, manage and optimise paid campaigns — primarily on LinkedIn and Meta.

• Translate business and brand strategies into actionable paid media plans that drive measurable results.

• Collaborate with Content, Tech and Brand Strategy specialists to ensure integrated execution.

• Advise clients on how paid, content and tech can strengthen marketing and sales effectiveness.

• Contribute to developing our paid frameworks and thought leadership within B2B activation.

• Work closely with the team on performance reporting and the use of HubSpot to connect paid activity to pipeline and revenue.

Your profile

• 3–5 years of experience in paid media strategy and execution, preferably within B2B marketing.

• Proven experience managing LinkedIn Campaign Manager and Meta Business Suite.

• A strategic mindset with strong analytical and creative understanding.

• Confidence in client dialogue — able to advise senior stakeholders.

• Interest in cross-disciplinary collaboration and working closely with other specialists.

• Experience with HubSpot is a plus.

About Sunrise TcTa

Sunrise TcTa isn’t a large conglomerate agency with standardised processes. We’re a privately-owned boutique agency based in Copenhagen. Independent and built to develop tailor-made strategic and creative solutions across industries, mostly B2B and often with an international footprint.

Transitions are never easy.

But they’re often necessary.

Join us in working with the commercial ones.

Sunrise TcTa – Brand, Marketing & Commercial Strategy.

How to apply

If Sunrise sounds like the place for you, send your application and CV no later than 30 November 2026.

Please submit your application using the form below.

If you have any questions about the role, feel free to reach out to Jonathan Riis Gilmartin, Partner, Activation at jrg@sunrise.dk or by phone at +45 51 93 21 32.

**Our Purpose

**Planday from Xero is a leading digital solution that uncomplicates everyday scheduling and workforce management by making it easier for businesses and shift workers around the world to communicate, collaborate, and get work done.

Powered by a community of local industry experts, Planday provides a best-in-class digital platform that is easy to use, accurate, secure, and compliant with local needs and standards. From payroll and accounting to POS and reporting, its open API and tech ecosystem is scalable to fit shifting business needs and to build an engaged, flexible workforce.

Founded in 2004, Planday is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark and supports over 400,000 users across Europe, Australia and the US. Planday was acquired by Xero in 2021.

**How You’ll Make An Impact

**As our Lead Engineer- Data, you will set the architectural direction of the data platform that enables both the decisions we make internally and the data-driven features our customers rely on. Working with the Data, ML, Platform, and Product Engineering teams, you will keep ingestion, modelling, and orchestration dependable, and define the modelling, testing, and documentation standards the data function depends on. You will innovate on how people work with data, building the agentic tooling and semantic modelling that let teams across Planday work from trusted data with confidence.

**What You’ll Do

**

• Set the architectural direction of our data platform so it serves analytics, product engineering, and AI/ML from one coherent design, collaborating with Platform and ML engineering on shared infrastructure.

• Design the dbt models, semantic layer, and quality standards the data function depends on, with the validation and lineage to make them trustworthy downstream.

• Own orchestration and observability in Dagster, and onboarding new sources in a way that scales.

• Innovate on self-serve and AI-enabled analytics, from semantic models and agentic workflows to our BI layer.

• Build the historical and low-latency foundations that make predictive and real-time use cases possible.

• Introduce better modelling standards, tooling, and development environments.

• Keep the platform reliable, performant, cost-effective, and compliant.

**Success looks like

**

• Architecture that holds up as we scale and as new use cases emerge, and that other engineers follow as a pattern.

• Analysts ship faster and more efficiently because your tooling & standards remove friction.

• A drop in repeat requests to the data team, as stakeholders answer their own questions through agentic workflows.

• ML and product teams have the historical and real-time data they need, without bespoke workarounds.

• Strong working relationships with the Data, ML, and Platform teams.

**What You’ll Bring With You

**

• Deep, hands-on Snowflake and dbt experience: modelling, semantic layers, agents & skills, testing, performance and cost tuning.

• Production experience with a pipeline orchestrator, ideally Dagster (or similar Airflow, Prefect), including dependent workloads, partial failures, and observability.

• Modern cloud infrastructure (Azure/AWS/GCP) and Kubernetes experience deploying and operating containerised workloads, plus infrastructure as code (Terraform).

• Strong SQL & Python for pipelines, services, and automation.

• Software engineering discipline across CI/CD, testing, and code review.

• The ability to turn technical trade-offs into clear narratives that help stakeholders decide and trust the work.

• Experience operating data systems, including incident response, cost, and data privacy practices.

**At Planday, we offer you

**

• Benefits like pension, health insurance, inclusive support for new parents and generous vacation

• On top of your annual base salary, you are offered to be part of an Employee Share Plan

• Growth and progression opportunities – we want you to grow with us

• Flexible remote work

• Strong social culture with lots of team and company activities

• Meaningful work – everyone at Planday contributes to improving the lives of shift workers around the globe

• Healthy work-life balance and autonomous approach to work. We trust in you and your abilities

Finally, our offices are not just workplaces (although they are pretty nice and well-located, we have to say!). Plandayers are open and welcoming and at Planday, everyone has the freedom and support to show their true self at work.

_At Planday, we firmly believe that diversity and inclusion are the cornerstones of innovation and a vibrant workplace culture. As an equal opportunity employer, we strive to create an equitable experience for all candidates throughout the process. Please let us know if you need any reasonable adjustments during the application or interview process.

Leading the commissioning strategy, team and schedule from mobilisation to integrated systems testing.

**Role Overview

**The Commissioning Manager leads Sensori's commissioning function on a project, ensuring mechanical and electrical systems are started, tested and proven safely, in the right sequence and to the client's acceptance criteria. The role develops the commissioning plan and schedule, manages commissioning engineers and vendor resources, controls the interface with the client's commissioning agent, and integrates commissioning requirements into the construction program so that handover is predictable and fully documented.

**Principal Duties And Responsibilities

**

• Develop and own the project commissioning plan, including strategy, organisation, level definitions, sequences, acceptance criteria and documentation requirements.

• Build and maintain the commissioning schedule; integrate it with the construction program and drive readiness of systems and areas to support it.

• Lead, allocate and develop the team of commissioning engineers; coordinate vendor and subcontractor commissioning resources.

• Chair commissioning coordination meetings with construction, quality, Authorised Persons, vendors and the client's commissioning agent.

• Oversee development and approval of method statements, checklists, test scripts and integrated systems test procedures.

• Manage the energisation and start-up sequence in conjunction with the Senior Authorised Person, ensuring permits, isolations and safety controls are in place.

• Monitor test execution, witness critical tests and ensure results are recorded, reviewed and accepted in the commissioning management system.

• Manage the commissioning issues log; drive closure of deficiencies with construction teams, subcontractors and vendors.

About the Job

We are looking for a Senior Security Architect to shape and strengthen security across Stibo DX products, platforms, and cloud services. You will join a small, senior architecture team at the center of Stibo DX's transformation from self-hosted and hybrid deployments to a standardized, cloud-native SaaS platform.

This is a hands-on, embedded role. You will work with engineering, product, platform, operations, customer-facing teams, and legal to ensure security is built into our solutions by design, not added afterwards. You will turn security strategy and risk into practical architecture, reusable patterns, and controls that teams can implement.

Your goal is to establish a consistent security architecture across Stibo DX and give teams clear standards, patterns, and guardrails to make secure architecture decisions. Early priorities will include establishing a security architecture baseline, identifying key security gaps across our SaaS platform, strengthening security architecture reviews and threat modelling, and defining reusable security patterns for engineering teams.

The role is primarily focused on security architecture, product and platform security, and secure engineering practices. You will also drive the technical aspects of security governance and support compliance activities when needed, including security certifications, customer security requirements, regulatory obligations, risk assessments, policies, and audit preparation.

You will work alongside peer architects covering Software, Platform/Infrastructure, and Data/Integration, reporting to the Director of Solution Architecture. Our governance model is based on minimum necessary control: decisions close to teams, with oversight proportional to risk and impact.

Security remains a shared responsibility. The Senior Security Architect owns the security architecture direction, standards, patterns, and cross-cutting guidance, while Software, Platform/Infrastructure, and Data/Integration architects continue to consider and address security within their respective domains. Engineering teams remain responsible for implementing and operating the required controls.

What You'll Do

• Define security architecture strategy across Stibo DX products, platforms, and cloud services, including principles, standards, target architectures, guardrails, and roadmaps.

• Embed secure-by-design practices into product discovery, solution design, delivery, and operation, working with teams early rather than reviewing security only at the end.

• Lead security architecture reviews and threat modelling for product, platform, customer, and technology initiatives; identify risks and align on practical mitigation with accountable teams.

• Shape identity and access management covering authentication, authorization, federation, privileged access, service identities, secrets, and Zero Trust principles.

• Strengthen cloud and platform security for AWS, Kubernetes, networks, workloads, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, data, and shared SaaS platform capabilities.

• Define reusable security patterns and controls for APIs, integrations, multi-tenancy, tenant isolation, encryption, key management, logging, monitoring, vulnerability management, and secure configuration.

• Embed security in the software development lifecycle by defining practices and guardrails and helping teams integrate security into engineering practices, automation, architecture decision records, and delivery pipelines.

• Lead security governance and compliance work when needed including security policies, control design, risk assessments, evidence coordination, audit preparation, and remediation planning.

• Translate external requirements into technical action including customer security expectations, contractual commitments, privacy requirements, and relevant frameworks such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR, and CRA.

• Raise security maturity across Stibo DX through coaching, practical guidance, cross-team collaboration, and clear communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

What we're looking for

Experience

• 10+ years of experience across software engineering, cloud/platform engineering, or cybersecurity, with 4+ years in a senior security architecture or technical security leadership role.

• Proven experience designing and securing cloud-native, distributed, and microservices-based systems in production.

• Practical experience with SaaS and multi-tenant architectures, including tenant isolation, identity, data protection, and shared platform controls.

• Experience leading threat modelling, security architecture reviews, risk assessments, and remediation planning across multiple teams or product areas.

• Experience defining security standards, patterns, reference architectures, and governance that teams can apply in practice.

• Experience working with security and compliance frameworks and translating them into proportionate technical and organizational controls.

• Strong communication skills and the ability to influence engineers, architects, product leaders, operations, customers, legal, and senior stakeholders.

Technical expertise

• Cloud security, preferably AWS, and Kubernetes/container security.

• Identity and Access Management, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SAML, federation, privileged access, and service identities.

• Application, API, integration, and event-driven security.

• Network security, workload protection, secrets management, encryption, certificates, and key management.

• Secure software development lifecycle, DevSecOps, infrastructure as code, CI/CD security, and software supply-chain security.

• Security logging, monitoring, detection capabilities, vulnerability management, and incident preparedness.

• Threat modelling, security risk analysis, Zero Trust, and defense-in-depth principles.

Nice to have

• Experience leading or materially supporting ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR security controls, CRA, or similar initiatives.

• Experience with enterprise customer security assessments, contractual security requirements, and audit evidence coordination.

• Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, SABSA, AWS Certified Security - Specialty, or equivalent practical experience.

• Experience helping an organization establish or mature a security architecture and governance capability.

Personal qualities

• Hands-on and credible with engineers, while able to communicate security clearly with product, customers, legal, and leadership.

• Pragmatic and risk-based: able to balance security, usability, operational complexity, cost, and delivery speed without compromising critical controls.

• Collaborative and influential, using expertise, evidence, and trust rather than creating unnecessary gates.

• Structured and decisive, able to make risks, responsibilities, and architectural decisions explicit.

• Curious, adaptable, and motivated by building long-term security maturity while helping teams deliver now.

What We Offer

• Ownership of security architecture and a central role in shaping security governance and compliance maturity.

• Hands-on work on real product, platform, customer, and operational challenges, not security from an ivory tower.

• A small, senior architecture team with trust, autonomy, and meaningful responsibility.

• High visibility across product, engineering, operations, customer-facing teams, legal, and leadership.

• The opportunity to create reusable security practices and patterns with lasting impact across Stibo DX.
